name: Argamasilla de Alba (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Argamasilla de Alba (a cross of Saint John, chequy, and a windmill with Don Quixote on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Argamasilla de Alba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Argamasilla de Alba arms — cross of Saint John, chequy and windmill
